target.description: Destination of the UDP stream: IPv4 address or hostname with an optional :port (1-65535), e.g. 192.168.1.10, 192.168.1.10:11000 or pc.local:11000. The device sends the stream unencrypted over UDP to this address.

description:
Streaming operations available via the c64_stream tool.

Operations:
- start [write]: Start an Ultimate streaming session. The device sends an unencrypted UDP stream to the target (IPv4 address or hostname, optional :port). Required inputs: stream, target.
- stop [write]: Stop an active Ultimate streaming session. Required inputs: stream.
